name: silver-bw
title: Серебряный ч/б
description: Чёрно-белая плёнка Double-X с серебряным зерном: полный тональный диапазон без цифровой контрастности.
core: Shot on Arricam LT with Zeiss Super Speed primes, 35mm Kodak Eastman Double-X 5222 black-and-white film, T2.0, shallow depth of field, soft halation on highlights, rich silver-halide grain, lifted charcoal blacks, gentle contrast, no sharpening, no HDR.
grade: Silver monochrome: full tonal range from charcoal to soft white, no colour tint, window light shaping the face, gentle shadow detail.
video_motion: Handheld with micro-drift, never locked off.
video_dialogue: Naturalistic performance, real dialogue sync, no music.
